title: feat: Add autopkgtests
commit_message:
feat: Add autopkgtests

Until now jq did not have any valid autopkgtests. Now included are:
    * make-check-test: validates that the `Makefile` can be correctly
      created and then runs the build-time tests availble in `tests/`
    * smoke-test (superficial): verifies a simple JSON echo can be prettified

* Also updated d/ch

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..272e951
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/make-check-test
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -ex
+
+QUILT_PATCHES=debian/patches quilt push -a -f -v || true
+
+# Copy the package source somewhere safe
+source=${0%/*}/../..
+build=$(mktemp -d --tmpdir=${AUTOPKGTEST_TMP})
+cp -a ${source}/* ${build}/
+cd ${build}
+
+# De-configure if needed
+if [ -f debian/autoreconf.before ]; then
+  dh_autoreconf_clean
+fi
+
+# Reconfigure
+dh_autoreconf
+dh_auto_configure
+
+# Run the upstream tests
+make check
+
+# Log the test output
+if [ -f test/test-suite.log ]; then
+  cat test/test-suite.log
+fi
+
+QUILT_PATCHES=debian/patches quilt pop -a -v || true
+rm -rf .pc/
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/debian/tests/smoke-test b/debian/tests/smoke-test
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3dd6821
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/smoke-test
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -ex
+
+# Test that simple operations like $(echo xyz | jq '.') are successful
+
+export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
+if [ "${AUTOPKGTEST_TMP}" = "" ] ; then
+  AUTOPKGTEST_TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/${pkg}-test.XXXXXX)
+  trap "rm -rf ${AUTOPKGTEST_TMP}" 0 INT QUIT ABRT PIPE TERM
+fi
+
+QUILT_PATCHES=debian/patches quilt push -a -f -v || true
+
+EXPECTED='{
+  "Penguins": {
+    "taxonomy": {
+      "kingdom": "Animalia",
+      "phylum": "Chordata",
+      "class": "Aves",
+      "order": "Sphenisciformes",
+      "family": "Spheniscidae",
+      "genus": "Aptenodytes"
+    },
+    "Famous entires": [
+      "Tux",
+      "Pingu",
+      "Empoleon",
+      "Eiscue",
+      "Badtz-Maru",
+      "Chilly Willy",
+      "Skipper",
+      "Kowalski",
+      "Rico",
+      "Private",
+      "Gunter",
+      "Pororo",
+      "Wheezy"
+    ]
+  }
+}'
+RESULT=$(echo '{"Penguins":{"taxonomy":{"kingdom":"Animalia","phylum":"Chordata","class":"Aves","order":"Sphenisciformes","family":"Spheniscidae","genus":"Aptenodytes"}, "Famous entires":["Tux", "Pingu", "Empoleon", "Eiscue", "Badtz-Maru", "Chilly Willy", "Skipper", "Kowalski", "Rico", "Private", "Gunter", "Pororo", "Wheezy"]}}' | jq '.')
+
+if [[ "${RESULT}" != "${EXPECTED}" ]] ; then
+    false
+fi
+
+QUILT_PATCHES=debian/patches quilt pop -a || true
+rm -rf .pc/
\ No newline at end of file
